prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE square seamless material for the CUT SURFACE OF A CONTINUOUS UNDERGROUND ROCK MASS, in a stylized mobile dungeon game. This is solid bedrock surrounding rooms carved into it, viewed like a cutaway roof/earth cross section. It is NOT an outdoor ground, NOT a cave floor scattered with pebbles, NOT a landscape. Reference image is the hand-painted slate-blue masonry style and palette only. Top-down unprojected square texture, uniform ambient light, to map later onto the top XY plane of an isometric grid. Dense continuous dark blue-black rock #101722 through #202b40, fine irregular geological fissures, softly painted shallow facets, small subdued mineral seams. Fine scale: frequent subdued angular pieces 30–90px across in a 1024 canvas; no giant slab dominating the tile. No separately outlined cobblestones, no visible soil, no gravel scatter, no free-standing boulders, no plants, no crystals, no central composition, no horizon, no vignetting, no illumination bloom. Low contrast, desaturated and dark: the inhabited blue-grey masonry rooms must read brighter against this surrounding unexcavated stone. The whole canvas must be a uniform solid rock mass, without holes. Opposite edges must join seamlessly, tileable on both axes. Full bleed opaque square, no text, no border, no UI.
